coverage.note: The final directory contains 107 unique runtime captures. Manual review covers the twelve reference routes and the listed expanded/fix states; the execution report is broader than the manual-image list.

resolved_previous_findings.result: Paperwhite rows begin after the full selection action area. Both device layouts show separate, readable actions and selected rows without the prior six-pixel overlap.

Completed jobs offer reading and confirmed record removal instead of ineffective pause/resume/cancel. The confirmation, cancellation, and removal states match their sidecars. Global actions are disabled when inapplicable; only resume is enabled for the failed-job fixture.
All twelve pages keep the same panel and pager geometry, including the partially populated final page. Rows remain 52 units and Paperwhite pager targets 48 units.
The ordinary all batch retains nine completed jobs and queues 77; unread retains nine completed jobs and queues 51. The initial completed chapters 27..35 keep their completed state.
Provider status is localized and the cached offline source retains its listing labels.
Tagged book summaries retain book tags, while cache-info and About summaries omit unrelated tags.

The direct footer, orientation, and seek interaction surfaces use 48/56-unit targets. The reader control area's upper edge and explanation/seek elements move upward to make room, while chapter-navigation and bottom-toolbar positions remain stable.

known_required_findings.description: Feedback moved off the pager but now covers the sixth Paperwhite chapter row. The notice occupies about y=702..756 while chapter 81's row spans about y=688..738.
known_required_findings.recommendation: Use a non-obstructing feedback region rather than placing the notice over another content row.

known_required_findings.description: The common Tab visual position is aligned, but Catalog and History draw their gray divider over the selected black marker. The selected marker is still split into black/gray/black scanlines.
known_required_findings.recommendation: Paint the continuous divider behind the selected marker.

new_findings.title: An empty or entirely retained completed batch reports queued work
new_findings.description: The shared review identified the no-pending-work branch as still producing queued feedback even when the selection is empty or every requested chapter remains valid and completed.
new_findings.recommendation: Base feedback on the actual accepted pending, paused, retained-completed, and empty outcomes.
new_findings.evidence_scope: Reported static/data edge case acknowledged by root; it is not misrepresented as a visible failure in the mixed-state batch screenshots.

explicit_adaptations: The seek and reader control area moves upward by 16 Paperwhite or 24 Scribe design pixels to honor minimum physical touch sizes without overlapping chapter-navigation targets. This differs slightly from the smaller mock control area and is an intentional sizing adaptation.
The manual orientation control keeps the Locked Direction label rather than claiming unsupported automatic rotation.
The true directory page count, dynamic source/queue/read counts, and canonical comic-page artwork remain governed by the previously recorded data policy.

native_persistence_gate.scope: Earlier native R4 candidate in the isolated Kindle firmware guest; no physical-device claim.
native_persistence_gate.limitation: The evidence supports closing the earlier persistence and stock-restoration blockers. It is not presented as executing the current desktop candidate on a physical Kindle.

unconfirmed_font_observation.description: The two-character About heading appears lighter than denser headings, but there is no evidence of missing glyphs or an incorrect font binding. No suggestion or clean-round penalty is created from this unconfirmed observation.

verification_note: This reviewer only read static images, sidecars, source text, and existing reports. Static PNG color samples are image inspection, not an application test. No local application, build, validation suite, smoke test, or runtime probe was executed. Despite automated passes and zero independently new important findings, the two known defects and the shared feedback edge case prevent a clean round.
